enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping with the air conditioner and fan running to stay cool through the hot night
enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on the bed. Pull the sheet over the legs. Turn onto the right side. Place the arm under the pillow. Turn the head toward the fan. Turn onto the back. Shift the legs under the sheet. Turn onto the left side. Pull the pillow closer. Adjust the arm position. Turn onto the right side again. Push the sheet down to the waist. Reach out and touch the fan control on the bedside table. Lie still on the back. Turn onto the left side. Keep the air conditioner remote within reach on the nightstand.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face, brushing teeth and taking a quick cool shower before the early shift
enriched_activities.desc: Open the eyes. Sit up on the bed. Swing the legs off the bed. Stand up. Walk to the bathroom door. Push the door open. Step inside. Turn on the bathroom light. Turn on the tap. Cup the hands. Splash water on the face. Turn off the tap. Pick up the towel. Wipe the face. Pick up the toothbrush. Squeeze toothpaste onto the bristles. Brush the teeth. Rinse the mouth with water. Turn on the shower tap. Step into the shower. Wash the body with soap. Rinse off. Turn off the shower tap. Step out. Pick up the towel. Dry the body. Wrap the towel around the hair. Walk out of the bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing and eating a quick breakfast of toast and fruit with a cup of tea, keeping hydrated for the heatwave day
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the kitchen. Turn on the kitchen light. Open the refrigerator door. Take out the bread. Take out the fruit. Close the refrigerator door. Place the bread slices in the toaster. Press the toaster lever down. Fill the kettle with water. Place the kettle on its base. Press the kettle switch on. Pick up a knife. Cut the fruit on the cutting board. Pick up the toast from the toaster. Place the toast on a plate. Pour hot water into a cup. Add a tea bag to the cup. Sit down at the table. Eat the toast. Eat the fruit. Drink the tea. Stand up. Carry the plate and cup to the sink. Turn on the tap. Rinse the plate and cup.

enriched_activities.activity: Dressing in light work clothes, packing a water bottle, lunch and small personal items for the shift
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into Bedroom 1. Open the wardrobe door. Take out a light shirt. Take out trousers. Close the wardrobe door. Put on the shirt. Put on the trousers. Sit on the bed. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Tie the laces. Stand up. Open the drawer. Take out the ID badge. Clip the badge to the shirt. Pick up the water bottle from the desk. Open the bottle cap. Fill the bottle at the kitchen tap. Screw the cap back on. Place the bottle in the bag. Place the lunch box in the bag. Place the phone in the bag. Place the keys in the bag. Zip the bag closed. Lift the bag onto the shoulder. Walk out of the bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to the hospital for the day shift, travelling early to avoid the worst of the heat
enriched_activities.desc: Walk out of the front door. Close the door. Lock the door with the key. Walk down the stairs. Step outside the building. Walk along the pavement to the bus stop. Stand at the bus stop. Take out the phone. Check the bus arrival time on the phone. Put the phone back in the pocket. Step onto the bus. Tap the card on the reader. Walk down the aisle. Sit on an empty seat. Hold the bag on the lap. Stand up at the stop. Walk to the front door. Step off the bus. Walk to the hospital entrance. Push the entrance door open. Walk to the staff room. Open the locker. Place the bag inside. Close the locker.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional: patient checks, medication rounds, clinical documentation and coordinating care with the ward team
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the nurse station. Pick up the patient handover sheet. Read the sheet. Walk to the first patient room. Knock on the door. Push the door open. Walk to the bedside. Greet the patient. Pick up the blood pressure cuff. Wrap the cuff around the patient's arm. Press the start button on the monitor. Read the numbers on the screen. Remove the cuff. Place the cuff back on the trolley. Pick up the thermometer. Place it near the patient's forehead. Read the temperature. Write the readings on the chart. Ask the patient about pain level. Say goodbye to the patient. Walk out of the room. Walk to the medication room. Open the medication cabinet. Take out the medication cups. Check the labels against the medication chart. Place the pills into the cups. Place the cups on the trolley. Push the trolley to the patient rooms. Hand the cups to the patients. Give water to the patients. Return the trolley to the medication room. Close the cabinet. Walk to the computer at the nurse station. Sit down. Type the clinical notes into the computer. Save the record. Stand up. Attend the ward team meeting. Report the patient status to the team. Write down the instructions on the notepad. Walk back to the ward. Answer the phone at the nurse station. Speak to the caller about patient transfer. Hang up the phone. Pick up the water bottle. Drink water. Walk to the next patient room. Assist the patient to sit up. Adjust the pillow behind the patient's back. Help the patient to the chair. Open the window blinds. Walk to the supply room. Pick up the gloves and dressing packs. Carry them to the treatment room. Open the dressing pack. Assist the doctor during the dressing change. Dispose of the used materials in the bin. Take off the gloves. Wash the hands at the sink. Write the procedure in the chart. Walk to the nurse station. Check the shift checklist. Tick off the completed tasks. Pick up the bag from the locker. Walk out of the ward. Say goodbye to the colleagues.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting home after the shift, picking up a few groceries on the way
enriched_activities.desc: Walk out of the hospital. Walk to the bus stop. Stand at the bus stop. Step onto the bus. Tap the card on the reader. Sit on a seat. Stand up at the stop. Step off the bus. Walk to the grocery store. Push the store door open. Pick up a shopping basket. Walk down the aisle. Pick up a bottle of water. Place it in the basket. Pick up vegetables. Place them in the basket. Pick up a carton of milk. Place it in the basket. Walk to the checkout counter. Place the items on the counter. Pay with the card. Place the items in the bag. Walk out of the store. Walk along the pavement. Walk up the stairs. Open the front door. Step inside. Close the door.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a cool shower and changing out of work clothes after a hot day on the ward
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the bedroom. Place the grocery bag on the kitchen counter. Walk into Bedroom 1. Take off the work shirt. Take off the trousers. Place the clothes in the laundry basket. Walk to the bathroom. Push the door open. Turn on the bathroom light. Turn on the shower tap. Step into the shower. Wash the body. Rinse off. Turn off the shower tap. Step out. Pick up the towel. Dry the body. Dry the hair. Walk into Bedroom 1. Open the drawer. Take out a t-shirt. Put on the t-shirt. Take out shorts. Put on the shorts. Hang the towel on the hook.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking and eating dinner while drinking extra water to rehydrate
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the kitchen. Turn on the kitchen light. Open the refrigerator door. Take out the vegetables. Take out the protein. Close the refrigerator door. Place the items on the counter. Pick up the knife. Cut the vegetables on the cutting board. Turn on the induction cooker. Place the pan on the cooker. Pour oil into the pan. Add the vegetables to the pan. Stir with the spatula. Add the protein. Stir again. Add salt. Turn off the induction cooker. Pick up a plate. Slide the food onto the plate. Carry the plate to the table. Sit down. Pick up the fork. Eat the dinner. Pick up the cup. Fill it with water at the tap. Drink the water. Refill the cup. Drink again.

enriched_activities.activity: Cleaning up the kitchen, loading the dishwasher and putting away leftovers in the refrigerator
enriched_activities.desc: Stand up from the table. Pick up the plate. Carry the plate to the sink. Scrape the leftovers into the container. Close the container lid. Open the refrigerator door. Place the container on the shelf. Close the refrigerator door. Turn on the tap. Rinse the plate. Rinse the cup. Turn off the tap. Open the dishwasher door. Pull out the lower rack. Place the plate in the rack. Place the cup in the rack. Place the fork in the basket. Push the rack in. Close the dishwasher door. Press the start button on the dishwasher. Pick up the sponge. Wipe the counter. Wipe the induction cooker surface. Turn off the kitchen light. Walk out of the kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing on the sofa watching TV with the space heater off and the room kept cool by the air conditioner
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the living room. Turn on the living room light. Pick up the air conditioner remote. Press the power button. Press the temperature down button. Place the remote on the coffee table. Pick up the TV remote. Press the power button on the TV remote. Sit down on the sofa. Press the channel button on the remote. Watch the TV screen. Pick up the phone. Scroll through messages on the phone. Place the phone on the sofa. Stand up. Walk to the kitchen. Open the refrigerator. Take out a bottle of water. Close the refrigerator. Walk back to the living room. Sit on the sofa. Open the bottle cap. Drink water. Close the bottle cap. Place the bottle on the coffee table. Pick up the TV remote. Press the volume button. Watch the TV. Stand up. Walk to the light switch. Turn off the living room light. Sit back on the sofa. Press the power button on the TV remote. Stand up. Walk to Bedroom 1.

enriched_activities.activity: Loading and running the washing machine for a small load of laundry and hanging the clothes to dry
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the bathroom. Turn on the bathroom light. Pick up the laundry basket. Open the washing machine door. Take the clothes out of the basket. Place the clothes into the drum. Close the washing machine door. Open the detergent drawer. Pour detergent into the drawer. Close the detergent drawer. Press the power button on the washing machine. Press the start button. Turn off the bathroom light. Walk to the bedroom. Open the wardrobe. Take out the drying rack. Carry the drying rack to the living room. Unfold the drying rack legs. Place the drying rack near the window. Walk back to the bathroom. Turn on the bathroom light.

enriched_activities.activity: Using the phone and computer at the desk to check messages, review tomorrow's roster and wind down under the fan
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into Bedroom 1. Turn on the desk lamp. Pull out the chair. Sit down at the desk. Open the laptop lid. Press the power button on the computer. Wait for the screen to load. Type the password on the keyboard. Open the message application. Read the messages. Type a reply. Press the send key. Open the roster file. Scroll down the page. Read the shift times. Close the file. Pick up the phone from the desk. Press the phone screen on. Scroll through the notifications. Type a message on the phone. Press the send button. Place the phone on the desk. Press the power button on the computer. Close the laptop lid. Turn the fan switch on. Stand up. Push the chair under the desk.

enriched_activities.activity: Night-time routine: brushing teeth, washing face and preparing for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the bathroom. Turn on the bathroom light. Pick up the toothbrush. Squeeze toothpaste onto the bristles. Brush the teeth. Turn on the tap. Rinse the mouth. Rinse the toothbrush. Place the toothbrush in the holder. Turn off the tap. Cup the hands under the water. Splash water on the face. Pick up the towel. Wipe the face. Hang the towel on the hook. Turn off the bathroom light. Walk out of the bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping with the air conditioner set to a comfortable temperature for the hot night ahead
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into Bedroom 1. Close the bedroom door. Pick up the air conditioner remote. Press the power button. Press the temperature button. Place the remote on the nightstand. Turn off the desk lamp. Pull back the sheet. Lie down on the bed. Pull the sheet over the body. Turn onto the right side. Place the arm under the pillow. Turn onto the back. Turn onto the left side. Adjust the pillow under the head. Lie still on the back. Turn onto the right side. Keep the eyes closed. Remain lying in the bed.
